proof.text: Use Mathlib evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits with hp to prove that p is a presheaf ring colimit. Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone gives a ring-sheaf colimit; hι and Sheaf.sheafifyCocone_ι_app_val identify it by Cocone.ext with the underlying ring-sheaf cocone of the supplied algebra cocone.

Prove locally that forgetting ring sheaves to abelian sheaves preserves the directed colimit. The composite forgetful functor on commutative rings preserves limits and filtered colimits. Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.instPreservesSheafification and sheafComposeNatIso identify sheafification followed by forgetting with forgetting followed by sheafification. Apply preservation to a presheaf colimit cocone and transfer along the invertible sheafification counit using preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram. This gives the underlying abelian sheaf colimit.

Prove locally that SheafOfModules.toSheaf preserves colimits: PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf preserves them, module sheafification is left adjoint, and sheafificationCompToSheaf is definitionally the abelian sheafification composite. Apply preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone and transfer along the invertible module-sheafification counit. Since toSheaf reflects isomorphisms and the module diagram has a colimit, reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms gives reflection of the colimit. The abelian cocone obtained from commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor is definitionally the one obtained from the underlying ring sheaves, so isColimitOfReflects closes the theorem.
